what: A round floating button at the bottom right hides below half the screen height on the first screen, then after scrolling only 50px it pops up in .5s with an overshoot curve (overshoots 18% at the end and returns). Back at the top it sinks in .5s, and when the bottom section enters the screen it turns transparent in .5s. With axis: x it can also slide in sideways from outside the right edge of the screen (like a round menu button appearing after passing the first page header).

options.from: Hidden position, default 50vh (120% when axis is x) — px and % both work
options.ease: Rising curve (CustomEase path or GSAP name), default is the original overshoot path — back.out(1.7) if CustomEase is missing
options.until: When this element (css) reaches the bottom of the screen, it becomes transparent (bottom strip, footer) — if empty, it never disappears
options.axis: with x, it slides in from the side (outside right), default y (rises from below) — brand-brand round menu button
options.out: Hide length (s), default dur — brand-brand enters at .6 and exits at .4
options.look: fade — transparent while hidden (0 ↔ 1 with the same length and curve as the slot)

use: Inquiry

from.where: shared.js floating red contact circle (.floatCv — original main.bundle floatCv: set y 50vh, scroll top+=from 50px with .5s CustomEase to y 0, back to y 50vh on return, autoAlpha 0 .5s on touching .pageBottom)
